requirements: R1: The system must validate and store procedural steps and author approvals when a protocol is added.
R2: The system must validate and store sample metrics and collection parameters when epidemiological data is uploaded.

slices.title: Patch backend generic material entity to support distinct protocol and data structures
slices.jtbd: When implementing distinct entities for this epic, I want to patch the existing Java service to handle protocol and data attributes natively, so that researchers can search and view them as distinct types.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user submits a protocol, When the backend processes it, Then procedural steps and author approvals are validated and stored.
Given a user uploads raw epidemiological data, When the backend processes it, Then sample metrics and collection parameters are validated and stored.
Given the single-slice constraint, When the epic is implemented, Then unit and integration tests covering the new structural validations must pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce validation failures for structured epidemiological attributes from 100% to 0%

epics.title: Material and Protocol Revision History Tracking
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated, I want the system to track previous versions and maintain a revision history, so that I can audit changes and revert to older versions to ensure clinical compliance and procedural safety.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase the successful retrieval rate of past document revisions to 100%
epics.tocConstraintRef: storage capacity for historical material revisions
requirements: R1: The system must track previous versions and maintain a revision history when a protocol or material is updated.
R2: The system must provide an API to retrieve the list of historical revisions and the content of any specific past version.

slices.title: Patch backend to track and retrieve material revisions
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to patch the existing update service to preserve older revisions, so that the revision history can be retrieved for compliance auditing.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited and saved, When its detailed page is viewed, Then a list of historical revisions showing who changed what and when is accessible.
Given a user selects a past version, When the view is requested, Then the content of that specific past version is displayed.
Given the single-slice constraint, When the epic is implemented, Then integration tests verify that older versions are correctly preserved and retrievable.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unrecorded material modifications to exactly zero

requirements: R1: The product must launch successfully without runtime failures.
R2: The product must pass its automated health check immediately after launch.

slices.title: Fix product launch and health check failure
slices.jtbd: When fixing the deployment configuration for this epic, I want to resolve the root cause of the failed launch, so that the product runs healthily and can be reviewed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application deployment configuration, When the full stack is launched via a single command, Then the system starts successfully without fatal errors.
Given the system is running, When the health check endpoint is probed, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given the single-slice constraint, When the fix is deployed, Then automated health checks are executed and pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce application startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
